regime.instructions: Classify the current market regime for this instrument from the snapshot.

criteria.trending: returns persistent in one direction, flow agrees with returns
criteria.mean_reverting: returns oscillate, flow and book lean against recent moves
criteria.high_vol: realized volatility or spread clearly elevated without crash dynamics
criteria.crisis: disorderly: wide spread, one-sided flow, sharp drop, liquidity vanishing

direction.instructions: Which position, if any, has positive expectancy over the next few bars after paying the spread? Prefer neutral when evidence is mixed. Instrument UNI-PERP. Research thesis (may be wrong): Uniswap fee switch live since Dec 2025 with a 100m UNI burn; value now accrues to the token. Watch-list only: reported annualized protocol revenue (26-58m, estimates differ) looks small against valuation and the price did not re-rate after activation. Thesis is invalidated by: 30-day holder revenue falls below the growth-budget issuance value; Governance raises issuance or redirects fees away from burns. Judge only from the snapshot; the thesis is context, not a vote.

toxic_flow.instructions: Proposition: recent aggressive order flow is informed, so a new taker order in the direction of the flow would be adversely selected.
